message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"Coral reefs, specifically the Great Barrier Reef, would immensely benefit from dedicated satellite monitoring."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events."}],"reasoning":"Clear rationale and users (marine/conservation scientists, reef managers implied) with footnoted sources. However, mission goals, objectives and requirements are not formally specified, the satellite's payload and specific function are vague, and the 'Oceans 30% more acidic' claim is loosely tied to bleaching. Users are identified but not fully developed."},{"id":"C2","level":"Accomplished","mark":8,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Week 10 is reserved for review, amendments, final simulations, and reflection."}],"reasoning":"Detailed Gantt chart with task descriptions, deadlines and reserved editing week provides some contingency. Planned sources and STK simulation sequencing are shown. Contingency and variations are limited, and linkage to mission narrative is modest, so placed at the lower end of Accomplished."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii"}],"reasoning":"Progress is described only as tutorials and reading. No preliminary orbit, launch or STK results, figures or interpretation are presented, so the technical evidence is insufficient for on-track status."},{"id":"C4","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic since the industrial revolution"},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue."}],"reasoning":"Clear headings and reasonable structure with footnoted references. Some inconsistencies: the 'Completed stages are gold' colour description and figure reference are informal; the 'more acidic' claim is inaccurately phrased (pH decrease); the ASU Asner reference is a citation placeholder; a stray apostrophe-level grammar issue appears. Figure is labelled but caption absent."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"partial","where":"Mission Concept & Rationale"},{"id":"R2","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R3","met":"partial","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"},{"id":"R5","met":"partial","where":"Useful Links"},{"id":"R6","met":"no","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"Claim that oceans are '30 percent more acidic' is incorrect phrasing; acidity increase corresponds to ~30% increase in hydrogen ion concentration (pH drop ~0.1)."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"Bathymetry resolution statement (100 m per pixel) is not a meaningful comparison to mission sensor requirements and no orbit/sensor requirements are derived."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","issue":"Software selection (STK) is mentioned only via tutorials; no justification or statement of licence/approval given."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","issue":"No orbit altitude, inclination, launch site or space-segment analysis presented, so R2 not addressed."}],"overall":"Good rationale and a detailed Gantt chart, but the report lacks mission requirements, space-segment analysis, and substantive preliminary technical results. Software choice and some factual phrasing need tightening. Overall a satisfactory but incomplete Part 1 submission."}
